thesis: The podcast discusses the historical skepticism surrounding early internet companies, noting that in 2009, starting a venture capital firm was viewed as a unique and bold move amidst the financial crisis. It recounts how the firm's early days involved raising funds when technology was widely considered useless and unlikely to generate revenue, contrasting this with the eventual success of companies like Facebook.
